last_push.commit_message:
docs: reconcile project docs with v3 plan

Adds SmartPress-v3-Plan.md as plan of record and CLAUDE.md as the
working rules for agents. Deletes AGENT-ONBOARDING.md: it was a
hand-rolled version of a convention Claude Code already has, and
nothing enforced it -- which is why its broken AI_CHANGELOG.md pointer
survived so long.

Master.md swaps the v2 build phases for the v3 Phase 1-3 structure,
keeping the Always-On Constraint verbatim with a noted amendment (the
backend health-check clause no longer applies). README and DEPLOY drop
Vercel, Cloud Run, Netlify and backend setup in favour of client-side
only. AI-Logs.md gains the Sprint 1.1 entry.

PROJECT-SYNC.json is CI-generated, so the generating workflow is fixed
too -- otherwise the next push would regenerate the stale values. It now
reads the version from package.json instead of grepping Master.md.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
